No badge currently claims hypothesis_testing, regression, experimental_design or causal_inference, so Phase 5 must name which existing badges gain them. The I Do / We Do / You Do / self-check flywheel holds structurally through the 24/8/8 contract, apart from the S18 selfCheck replacement and the causal subtopic overload.

Teaching 3.5x as "lift" plants the most common readout error in product analytics. (b) With 2 control conversions out of 20, a resample has zero control conversions with probability 0.9^20 = 0.122. In about 12% of resamples the ratio divides by zero, so the percentile CI is inf/nan. If the code drops those resamples instead, the interval is silently conditioned and biased. The design names this exercise as the hook for S37-T3-A's delta method, and the delta method for a ratio is also unreliable when the denominator is p=0.1 at n=20.
